Division is a multiplication fact in disguise

Solve & Share: Kara's party bags

Kara puts 30 toys into 5 party bags. She puts the same number of toys into each bag. How many toys are in each bag?

Toys left: 30
5 × 6 = 30  so  30 ÷ 5 = 6

Each round puts 1 toy in each of the 5 bags. 6 rounds use all 30 toys. Each bag has 6 toys.

Two ways to write a division problem

24dividend ÷x 4divisor =x 6quotient
6 4 24
divisordividendquotient
  • The dividend is the number of objects we share.
  • The divisor is the number we divide by.
  • The quotient is the answer.
